items.q: Who owns the images I generate?
items.a: You do. Images generated from your prompts belong to you and can be used in your own projects.
Demo images are shown at web size. Full resolution downloads are part of the paid plans.

items.q: Can I use the images commercially?
items.a: Yes, images you generate can be used in commercial work, including ads and covers.
A clear subject, one mood and a setting. For example: a subject, a place and the light you want.

items.q: Can I edit an image after generating it?
items.a: You can generate variations from the same prompt. A built in editor is planned for a later release.

footer.privacyText: Prism stores only the account details you provide and the images you save. Demo prompts stay in your browser and are never sent to a server. You can delete your account and images at any time.
footer.termsText: Prism is provided as is for image generation. You own the images you generate from your prompts. Final pricing, limits and availability are confirmed on the pricing page before you pay.
